title: 1D Vibration - Eigenvalue Problem (FEM)
desc.intro: Problem 5.2.6: solution of a 1D eigenvalue problem, vibration of a solid body. This code solves the free vibration of a 1D bar with FEM, computing natural frequencies and mode shapes by solving the eigenvalue problem.
desc.features.title: Features
desc.features.bc.label: Boundary conditions
desc.features.props.label: Variable properties
desc.features.analyses.label: Analyses
desc.features.analyses: Natural frequencies, mode shapes, material properties
desc.features.presets.label: Preset cases
desc.features.presets: Steel bar, aluminum bar, concrete column, composite bar
desc.features.analytical.label: Analytical solution
desc.features.analytical: Comparison with analytical results for constant properties
desc.eq.title: Differential equation
desc.eq.text: where u is the axial displacement, ρ(x) the variable density, A(x) the variable cross-sectional area and E(x) the variable Young's modulus.
desc.eig.title: Eigenvalue problem
desc.eig.text: where K is the stiffness matrix, M the mass matrix, φ the mode shapes and λ = ω² the eigenvalues (ω is the angular frequency).
desc.ana.title: Analytical solution
desc.ana.text: Available only for constant properties (constant E, ρ and A). For variable properties, only the FEM provides the numerical solution.
